findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Insecure HTTP usage
 * @description Using HTTP instead of HTTPS can lead to man-in-the-middle attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/insecure-http
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-319
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("aiohttp").getMember("ClientSession").getACall()
  or
  call = API::moduleImport("httpx").getMember("Client").getACall()
select call, "Potential HTTP client creation. Ensure HTTPS is used for secure connections."
findings.hypothesis: Insecure HTTP usage in aiohttp or httpx clients

message.text: Potential HTTP client creation. Ensure HTTPS is used for secure connections.
